page_notes.content: System benchmarks ensure optimization across TIRG Layers: 1) CogCost (Compute/Memory/Energy/Network), 2) Council Consensus Integrity (Supermajority > 0.67 with C17-NULLION adversarial check), and 3) Resource Limits. Outputs must clear the Multi-Gate Checkpoint (Logic 95%, Ethics 100%, Truth 98%, Clarity 95%, Paradox 92%) under Embedded Autonomous arbitration before final Quillan release.
